visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation opens on a stark white background. A cartoon orange-and-white tabby cat character appears, dressed in a grey business suit, white shirt, and red tie. The cat has a proud, squinted expression with its hands folded confidently. (2) The scene cuts as the cat's expression turns to one of sudden pain and shock. Its mouth is wide open, and yellow wavy lines indicating soreness radiate from its lower back. (3) A new cut shows the cat looking extremely confused or 'broken' mentally, with wide mismatched eyes, its tongue hanging out, and its paws clutching its head. (4) The final cut depicts the cat with swirling spiral eyes, indicating dizziness or impaired vision, while it holds a smartphone in its right paw.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio commences with a single male voice speaking Mandarin in a professional, slightly proud narrative tone. A rhythmic electronic BGM with a clear, steady beat plays in the background at a lower volume than the speech. (2) A sharp 'thud' sound effect punctuates the transition. The male voice raises its pitch and volume, shouting in a pained, high-arousal manner to match the visual of back pain. The BGM continues its upbeat tempo. (3) A second 'thud' impact SFX triggers. The voice shifts to a silly, exaggerated high-pitched tone, reflecting a state of confusion or mental breakdown. The BGM remains consistent and bright. (4) A final 'thud' SFX occurs. The voice becomes dizzy and slightly muffled, delivering the final line about sensory decline. The electronic beat persists until the audio ends abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a self-deprecating comedic effect by subverting expectations. It starts with a proud statement about achieving things at a young age, only to reveal those 'achievements' are physical and mental ailments typically associated with the elderly.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Short-form animation using a recurring character (Mochi Dad) to deliver a punchline joke about premature aging.
